title: Persist the approval the user actually requested
when: At intake when the user asks for screenshots, visual proof, conditional review or explicit personal approval.
need: A screenshot alone does not add approval. Unconditional human review differs from human-if-unsure; use the correct item-scoped policy and named reviewer, without modifying shared defaults for one request.
surface: Idea/Dash delivery evidence intake; QA verdict-mode contract
gap: Review question: should FIRST-USER D include explicit approve-it versus show-evidence scenarios so successful QA cannot silently skip requested review?
